title: AL-Go for Github June Office Hour

chapters.title: Preview Feature 1: Starter Dashboard for AL-Go Telemetry

features.name: AL-Go Version 7.2
features.description: General availability release containing features previously in preview, including improvements to workflows and system file management.

features.name: Starter Dashboard for AL-Go Telemetry
features.description: A plug-and-play Azure Data Explorer report that provides basic reporting capabilities for AL-Go telemetry, showing running workflows, failures, runner usage, AL-Go versions, and deprecated settings.
features.status_evidence_quote: they're all in preview. Uh so yeah, not available in 7.2. Uh but they will be available in 7.3 when we release that.
caveats: Requires downloading JSON file from repository and filling in configuration

features.name: Custom Template Repositories
features.description: Capability to add your own template repository that can be used to spawn other repositories with custom scripts or workflows, similar to how AL-Go PTE or AL-Go AppSource works today. Changes sync when running update AL-Go system files.
features.status_evidence_quote: They're all in preview, like I said, so you won't be able to find them in version 7.2.
caveats: Requires management of template repository updates
Need to sync changes when updating system files

features.name: Custom Jobs in AL-Go Workflows
features.description: Ability to add custom jobs to AL-Go YAML files by prefixing with custom-job- prefix, allowing users to extend CI/CD pipelines with their own jobs.
features.status_evidence_quote: They're all in preview, like I said, so you won't be able to find them in version 7.2.
caveats: No guarantee job names won't change in future versions
Requires careful review when updating system files
Customizations may break with future AL-Go updates

features.name: AL-Go Version 5.0 End of Support
features.description: AL-Go versions lower than 5.0 will break very soon and users are strongly advised to upgrade.
caveats: Version 5.0 was released more than a year ago
